title: Patiala’s Counterstrokes Fail on Both Fronts

blocks.text: Amar Singh next widens the contest by sending allied contingents against the Khalsa flanks and rear. Sudhrai's men are told to strike from behind, but S. Dulcha Singh's contingent rushed to block their passage while Baghel Singh shifts support where the line is under greatest pressure.

The fighting becomes a prolonged trial of nerve. Whosoever blinked and thought of retracing his steps first would yield the field, yet the Khalsa holds while the opposition begins to break under sustained attack.

By the end of the page, Malwa forces got uprooted on both the battle fronts despite the deployment of additional Rohilla and hill infantry. The attempted counterstroke only confirms that Baghel Singh's side now owns the momentum of the battle.
